title: Why ETL transforms consume weeks of engineering time
text: Hi, I am Hussein and this video is about how AI is changing data engineering, moving data from one pipeline into another and why ETL is finally getting simpler. Not because a model builds your warehouse, because the boring 90% stops being handwritten.

title: Schema mapping with Claude: Instructing AI not to guess
text: Every pipeline has the same shape, source, destination and a mountain of glue in between. Rename this column, cast that timestamp. Guard the null the vendor swears never happens. Extract and load are easy, the transform in the middle is where the weeks go. So, here's the ask I actually give

title: Catching float-to-decimal bugs and nullability mismatches
text: Claude, not build my pipeline. Two schemas and one instruction, map the columns, flag every mismatch you cannot resolve and do not guess. 12 columns line up, three do not. Created at as a string going into a timestamp. Amount is a float going into a decimal. A rounding bug waiting for month-end. Customer ID is nullable on one side, not null on the

title: Why a clean-running pipeline isn't necessarily right
text: Other. Claude found all three, it decided none of them. And this is what it wrote, one rule per flag, parse the date, move money off the float, make the null explicit instead of silently dropping the row. Read it like a diff, not like an answer. It is genuinely good at mapping schemas, boilerplate tests and 2:00 a.m. stack

title: Shifting focus: Asking AI for production failure assertions
text: Traces. It cannot tell you what the number means, what the business promised or what downstream was guaranteed. It writes the pipeline, it does not own it. The pipeline runs clean, green check, row counts match, nobody gets paged while a bad cast quietly rounds every amount the wrong way. A pipeline that runs is not one that is right. So, the verdict, AI collapses the glue, not the judgement. It flags the mismatches, it never resolves them. It makes code review the most valuable skill on the team, writing just got free, reading did not. Your turn, paste this into Claude. Here's my source schema and my target schema. Map every column and for each mismatch, tell me the failure it causes in production and the assertion that would catch it. You are not asking for the mapping, you are asking for the test. Atol simplified the glue, not the judgement. I'm Hussein, thanks for watching.
